scope: Payment cancellation before settlement, recipient/admin partial and full compensating refunds, ADMIN full reversal, immutable adjustment history, idempotency, authorization and concurrent race proofs. P07 schedules/webhooks and P08-P11 remain later phases.

requirements.statement: The payer can cancel only a PENDING payment before settlement wins the payment lock; cancellation releases the ACTIVE hold exactly once, posts no journal, records audit/outbox/idempotency and safely absorbs later settlement delivery.
Cancellation is authorized only for the original payer or an ADMIN; unrelated customers receive a non-disclosing response and an ADMIN must supply a bounded recorded reason.

Synchronized cancellation and settlement across independent processes produce exactly one economic winner with one final payment/hold state, no leaked reservation, no duplicate journal and reconciled balances.

Recipient-authorized partial and full refunds are immutable compensating postings with distinct operation, journal, audit, outbox and idempotency identities; the original settlement journal remains unchanged and base state remains SETTLED.

Only the original recipient owner or ADMIN can refund; the payer cannot self-authorize, unrelated users cannot enumerate resources, invalid input is rejected before key claim and current recipient availability is required without overdraft.

Adjustment commands use actor/kind/payment/key scoped durable idempotency; same intent replays one operation, changed amount or reason conflicts, and a lost response is resolved by replaying the exact stored key and normalized intent.
Concurrent partial refunds lock the parent payment and balances so successful adjustments never exceed the original settlement and balances remain reconciled.

ADMIN full reversal requires a bounded reason, no prior adjustment and current recipient availability; it creates one full immutable compensating journal while preserving the original SETTLED payment and exposing REVERSED separately.

The complete forbidden-transition and race matrix rejects cancellation after settlement, reversal after refund, refund or a second reversal after reversal, refund before settlement, and reversal-versus-spending cannot double-spend recipient funds.

P06 exposes documented CSRF/idempotency-protected adjustment endpoints and owner/admin-scoped reads, applies a historical V8 migration with a deferred posting-integrity trigger, prevents runtime SQL bypass and extends independent reconciliation to adjustments.
